title: feat: Iteration 1 - Stock price direction prediction ML pipeline
body:
## Summary

- **Complete Iteration 1 ML pipeline** for predicting next-day stock price direction (binary classification)
- Modular architecture: `data/` (download + cache + preprocess), `features/` (technical indicators + labels + pipeline), `models/` (train + evaluate), `reports/` (CSV/JSON export)
- **4 models**: LogisticRegression, RandomForest, XGBoost, LightGBM with expanding window cross-validation (TimeSeriesSplit, 5 folds)
- **Two label versions**: A (threshold=0) and B (threshold=0.2%)
- **No data leakage**: StandardScaler fit only on train fold per CV split
- Data cached as both Parquet and CSV via yfinance; 28 technical indicator features using `ta` library
- CLI runner: `python main.py train --ticker JNJ --label-version A`
- Verified end-to-end: successfully trained all 4 models on JNJ with label version A, saved models and reports

## Test plan

- [x] `pip install -r requirements.txt` installs cleanly
- [x] `python main.py train --ticker JNJ --label-version A` completes without errors
- [x] Models saved to `models/saved/` (LogisticRegression.joblib, RandomForest.joblib, XGBoost.json, LightGBM.json, scaler.joblib)
- [x] Reports generated to `reports/` (CSV + JSON with per-fold and mean metrics)
- [ ] Run with `--label-version B` to test threshold-based labels
- [ ] Run with all default tickers to verify full pipeline
